title: Google\Cloud\Vision\V1\AnnotateFileResponse
name: AnnotateFileResponse
description: Response to a single file annotation request. A file may contain one or more images, which individually have their own responses.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.input_config
params.description: Information about the file for which this response is generated.

params.name: data.responses
params.description: Individual responses to images found within the file. This field will be empty if the error field is set.

params.name: data.total_pages
params.description: This field gives the total number of pages in the file.

params.name: data.error
params.description: If set, represents the error message for the failed request. The responses field will not be set in this case.
